test_title: PYST 48: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Although experts are worried / that retail inflation is rising / at a steep rate, / the crisis will soon blow away.

options.text: the crisis will soon blow away

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "blow away" is informal and does not convey the intended meaning in this context.
 
• A more appropriate phrase would be "pass" or "subside," meaning that the crisis will soon end or dissipate.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part C** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Although experts are worried that retail inflation is rising at a steep rate, the crisis will soon **pass**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **A: "that retail inflation is rising"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **B: "at a steep rate"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **D: "Although experts are worried"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
